name: Historical Calendar for Progressive Career
author: Dejw
description: Season calendars for Swofty Progressive Career, from 2015 to 2026. Steam only. EA app is unsupported in this release. Optional track addons are off by default and use standard circuits as substitutes.

options.label: Use Paul Ricard
options.description: Requires twilight.paul-ricard enabled in this profile. Standard substitute: Imola (2018, 2019), Shanghai (2021, 2022).

options.label: Use Portimao
options.description: Requires mod.portimao enabled in this profile. Standard substitute: Melbourne (2020, 2021).

options.label: Use Jerez
options.description: Requires pajko.jerez enabled in this profile. Standard substitute: Suzuka (2020).

options.label: Use Sochi
options.description: Requires mod.sochi enabled in this profile. Standard substitute: Jeddah (2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019), Montreal (2020, 2021).

options.label: Use Nurburgring
options.description: Requires mod.nurburgring enabled in this profile. Standard substitute: Zandvoort (2020).

options.label: Use Istanbul Park
options.description: Requires track.istanbul_park enabled in this profile. Standard substitute: Singapore (2020, 2021).

options.label: Use Bahrain Outer
options.description: Requires track.bahrain_outer enabled in this profile. Standard substitute: Bahrain GP (2020).

options.label: Use Hockenheim
options.description: Requires mod.hockenheim enabled in this profile. Standard substitute: Zandvoort (2016, 2018, 2019).

options.label: Use Sepang
options.description: Requires mod.bahrain24 enabled in this profile. Standard substitute: Losail (2015, 2016, 2017).
